key_insight: Kriging and neural-network models can predict pressure losses across perforated plates more accurately than standard empirical correlations, even with limited experimental data.
engineering_relevance: These data-driven pressure-loss models can be embedded into RANS simulations as source terms, improving CFD predictions for perforated-plate flows in engineering designs.
method: Built two predictive models: one kriging-based and one neural-network-based.
Trained and tested the models on two experimental datasets from the literature.
Compared model accuracy against widely used empirical pressure-loss formulas and validated integration in 2D RANS channel-flow simulations.
evidence_signal: Across the experimental datasets, both data-driven approaches generally matched measurements well and outperformed existing empirical models for most perforated-plate configurations.
watch_item: The models are trained on relatively limited experimental data, so extrapolation to unseen geometries or flow conditions should be done cautiously.
paper_title: Kriging and neural network models for pressure losses across perforated plates
